Usage

Success rate on the big cup: scatters the initial state n times (the ball hangs L below the pivot (the string hole of the cross-piece), with Gaussian perturbations σ = jitter_pos sideways and σ = jitter_vel on the velocity (tangential component)), swings up with swing_up_plan (hand starting point origin), and carries the cup with catch_plan_ballistic.

Planning: planner="staged" (default, catch_plan_staged: hold → carry → absorb; absorb=False does not lower on landing) or "plane" (catch_plan_ballistic, with clearance). lift default None = swing_up_lift (per trick, the apex is h_c + 0.9 r_b above the cup). If contact(hand, p) → 隙間 is passed, trials that touch the kendama fail with "hit_ken".

Perception: the default is noisy_perceiver (noise_pos [m], noise_vel [m/s]; 0 means ground truth). If perceiver_factory(i) → perceive is passed it is used (a new perception per trial i: a closed loop that predicts from images only with kendamaworld.camera_perceiver). The jitter of the initial state is determined by seed regardless of perception (with the same seed, ground-truth and image trials are paired). Return value {"rate", "n", "caught_list", "mean_lateral", "catch_times", "end_reasons", "laterals", "starts"} (mean_lateral = mean lateral offset at catch over caught trials, nan if none. starts = (p0, v0) of each trial). dodge / clearance go to swing_up_plan / catch_plan_ballistic (default = move the hand 10 cm toward the string-hole side (−y), and bring the cup back after the ball rises above the big cup's rim:

a stance in which the ball does not pass through the kendama. Without dodging (0, 0, 0) / False, the ball passed through the cup body in all 20 trials —— measured and rejected. Dodging to +y puts the ken in front of the ball as seen from camera 2, hiding the ball, and the lateral error of the image prediction rose from 0.14 → 2.8 mm). keep_runs=True keeps each trial's kendama_simulate return value and perception in "runs" / "perceivers". n ≤ 0 raises ValueError.

Empty input (kp as an empty dict) raises ValueError.
